title.zh: 卷十四 本紀第十四 憲宗二
title.raw: 卷十四 本紀第十四 憲宗二 Volume 14 Annals 14: Xianzong 2

sentences.zh: 成化十二年

translations.literal: Chenghua year twelve.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月辛亥，南京地震有聲。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, spring, first month, on the day xinhai, Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, in the first month of spring, on xinhai, Nanjing was shaken by a rumbling earthquake.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the new moon day yihai, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon yihai, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲午，敕臣修省。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the throne ordered officials to practice self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the emperor ordered his ministers to undertake court-wide self-examination.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，減內府供用物。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renzi, supplies for the inner palace were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renzi, the court cut inner-palace provisions.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，李震大破靖州苗。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Li Zhen inflicted a great defeat on the Jingzhou Miao.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Zhen routed the Jingzhou Miao.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丁卯，副都御史原傑撫治荊、襄流民。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on the day dingmao, Vice Censor-in-Chief Yuan Jie was sent to pacify and govern the displaced people of Jing and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on dingmao, Vice Censor-in-Chief Yuan Jie was dispatched to settle the Jing-Xiang refugees.

sentences.zh: 庚申，錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，黑眚見。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day gengxu, a black aberration appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengxu, a black celestial aberration was seen.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，躬禱天地於禁中，以用度不節、工役勞民、忠言不聞、仁政不施四事自責。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, he personally prayed to Heaven and Earth within the Forbidden City, blaming himself on four counts: immoderate expenditure, laboring the people with works, loyal words not heard, and benevolent government not enacted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the emperor prayed to Heaven and Earth within the palace, taking blame for four faults—wasteful spending, corvée that wearied the people, loyal counsel ignored, and humane rule not carried out.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，遣使錄天下囚。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, envoys were dispatched to review prisoners throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen envoys were sent to review prisoners empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day xinsi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinsi, an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月，巡撫四川都御史張瓚討灣溪苗，破之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Zhang Zan, regional inspector of Sichuan, campaigned against the Wanxi Miao and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhang Zan, Sichuan regional inspector, attacked the Wanxi Miao and broke them.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，置鄖陽府，設行都司所，處流民。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jichou, Yunyang Prefecture was established, a regional military commission and guard posts were set up, and displaced people were settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jichou, the court founded Yunyang Prefecture, posted a regional command and guards, and resettled refugees there.

sentences.zh: 是年，土魯番、撒馬兒罕、琉球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Turfan, Samarkand, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Turfan, Samarkand, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 成化十三年

translations.literal: Chenghua year thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: The thirteenth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月庚戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, spring, first month, on the day gengxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, in the first month of spring, on gengxu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 己巳，置西廠，太監汪直提督官校刺事。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Western Depot was established; the eunuch Wang Zhi was put in charge of palace guards to investigate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Western Depot was set up, with the eunuch Wang Zhi directing palace agents to ferret out intelligence.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，汪直執郎中武清、樂章，太醫院院判蔣宗武，行人張廷綱，浙江布政使劉福下西廠獄。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, Wang Zhi arrested Bureau Director Wu Qing, Music Master Yue Zhang, Court of Imperial Medicine Vice Director Jiang Zongwu, Courier Zhang Tinggang, and Zhejiang Administrative Commissioner Liu Fu and sent them to the Western Depot prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Wang Zhi seized Bureau Director Wu Qing, Music Master Yue Zhang, Court of Imperial Medicine Vice Director Jiang Zongwu, courier Zhang Tinggang, and Zhejiang administrative commissioner Liu Fu and jailed them in the Western Depot.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌，執左通政方賢下西廠獄。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiaxu, Left Assistant Commissioner Fang Xian was arrested and sent to the Western Depot prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiaxu, Left Assistant Commissioner Fang Xian was seized and imprisoned in the Western Depot.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大學士商輅、尚書項忠請罷西廠，從之。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Grand Secretary Shang Lu and Minister Xiang Zhong requested abolition of the Western Depot; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Grand Secretary Shang Lu and Minister Xiang Zhong petitioned to abolish the Western Depot, and the throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，罷項忠為民。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiachen, Xiang Zhong was dismissed and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiachen, Xiang Zhong was stripped of office and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，復設西廠。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the Western Depot was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Western Depot was restored.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，商輅致仕。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Shang Lu retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Shang Lu retired.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬戌，錦衣衞官校執工部尚書張文質繫獄，帝知而釋之。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on the day renxu, Brocade Guard agents arrested Minister of Works Zhang Wenzhi and imprisoned him; the Emperor learned of it and released him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on renxu, Brocade Guard agents seized Minister of Works Zhang Wenzhi and threw him into prison; when the emperor learned of it he ordered him freed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，復立哈密衞於苦峪谷，給土田牛種。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day wushen, the Hami Guard was re-established at Kuyu Valley and given land, oxen, and seed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen, the Hami Guard was re-founded at Kuyu Valley and granted fields, cattle, and seed grain.

sentences.zh: 十一月，張瓚破松潘疊溪苗。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Zhang Zan defeated the Songpan Diexi Miao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhang Zan routed the Songpan Diexi Miao.

sentences.zh: 是年，免浙江、山東、河南、江西、福建被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That year, land tax and grain tribute in disaster-stricken Zhejiang, Shandong, Henan, Jiangxi, and Fujian were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year land tax and grain tribute were forgiven in disaster-hit Zhejiang, Shandong, Henan, Jiangxi, and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 振山東、南畿州縣饑。

translations.literal: Famine in Shandong and districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was sent to famine in Shandong and the Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 安南、琉球、烏斯藏、暹羅、日本入貢。

translations.literal: Annam, Ryukyu, U-Tsang, Siam, and Japan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Embassies came from Annam, Ryukyu, U-Tsang, Siam, and Japan.

sentences.zh: 滿都魯、癿加思蘭各遣使貢馬。

translations.literal: Mandulu and Qara Hasan each sent envoys to present horses.
translations.idiomatic: Mandulu and Qara Hasan each sent envoys bearing horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 成化十四年

translations.literal: Chenghua year fourteen.
translations.idiomatic: The fourteenth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月甲戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, spring, first month, on the day jiaxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, in the first month of spring, on jiaxu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，免浙江被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuchen, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Zhejiang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuchen, autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜曾彥等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Zeng Yan and others were granted jinshi with distinctions of first rank, origin, and so forth.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Zeng Yan and others received jinshi degrees with distinctions of rank and origin.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷烏撒銀場。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the Wusa silver mine was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the Wusa silver mine was shut down.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，復開遼東馬市。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Liaodong horse market was reopened.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the Liaodong horse market was reopened.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以浙江饑罷採花木。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, because of famine in Zhejiang, the gathering of flowers and trees was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, with Zhejiang in famine, the court stopped collecting ornamental plants.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，免南畿、山東被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day dingyou, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region and Shandong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingyou, autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，太監汪直行遼東邊。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day guimao, the eunuch Wang Zhi went to the Liaodong frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guimao, the eunuch Wang Zhi toured the Liaodong border.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，遣使振畿南、山東饑。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day dingchou, envoys were dispatched to relieve famine south of the capital region and in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingchou, envoys were sent to relieve famine in the capital hinterland and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，以直隸、山東災傷，詔六部條卹民事宜。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guisi, because of disaster and injury in Zhili and Shandong, an edict ordered the Six Ministries to set forth measures to comfort the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guisi, with Zhili and Shandong stricken, the throne ordered the Six Ministries to draft relief measures for the people.

sentences.zh: 南京刑部侍郎金紳巡視江西水災。

translations.literal: Jin Shen, vice minister of justice at Nanjing, inspected flood damage in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shen, Nanjing vice minister of justice, toured Jiangxi to assess flood damage.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免湖廣被災秋糧。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-stricken Huguang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，下巡撫蘇、松副都御史牟俸於錦衣獄，謫戍。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Mou Feng, regional inspector of Suzhou and Songjiang, was arrested and sent to the Brocade Guard prison and banished to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Mou Feng, Suzhou-Songjiang regional inspector, was thrown into Brocade Guard prison and exiled to border garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，免畿內被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiawu, autumn grain tax within the metropolitan districts was remitted in disaster areas.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiawu, autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-hit districts around the capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、烏斯藏、撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, U-Tsang, and Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Champa, U-Tsang, and Samarkand sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 成化十五年

translations.literal: Chenghua year fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteenth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月丁卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, spring, first month, on the day dingmao, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, in the first month of spring, on dingmao, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，振山東饑，免秋糧。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, famine in Shandong was relieved and autumn grain tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi relief was sent to Shandong famine and autumn grain tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 二月，免湖廣被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the second month, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-stricken Huguang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔修開國勳臣墓，無後者置守塚一人。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, an edict ordered repair of the tombs of founding meritorious officials; where there were no heirs, one tomb keeper was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the court ordered the tombs of founding meritocrats restored and, where lineages had died out, a single tomb keeper appointed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，免南畿被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day bingwu, land tax and grain tribute in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingwu, land tax and grain tribute were forgiven in disaster districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 壬子，下駙馬都尉馬誠於錦衣獄。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, the emperor's son-in-law Ma Cheng was arrested and sent to the Brocade Guard prison.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the emperor's son-in-law Ma Cheng was seized and imprisoned by the Brocade Guard.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，汪直劾侍郎馬文升，下文升獄，謫戍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renxu, Wang Zhi impeached Vice Minister Ma Wensheng; Ma Wensheng was sent to prison and banished to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renxu, Wang Zhi denounced Vice Minister Ma Wensheng, who was jailed and exiled to the border.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以馬文升、牟俸事，杖給事中李俊、御史王濬五十六人於闕下。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, because of the affairs of Ma Wensheng and Mou Feng, fifty-six persons including Supervising Secretary Li Jun and Censor Wang Jun were beaten with the rod below the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, over the Ma Wensheng and Mou Feng cases, fifty-six officials including supervising secretary Li Jun and censor Wang Jun were flogged at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 己卯，免湖廣、河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, land tax and grain tribute in disaster-stricken Huguang and Henan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao land tax and grain tribute were remitted in disaster-stricken Huguang and Henan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，汪直行大同、宣府邊。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day guiyou, Wang Zhi went to the Datong and Xuanfu frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiyou, Wang Zhi toured the Datong and Xuanfu borders.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，撫寧侯朱永為靖虜將軍，充總兵官，汪直監軍，禦伏當加。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day dinghai, Marquis Zhu Yong of Funing was made Pacifying the Barbarians General, filling the post of supreme commander; Wang Zhi supervised the army; they defended against Boladaci.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dinghai, Zhu Yong, Marquis of Funing, was made Pacifying the Barbarians General and supreme commander, with Wang Zhi as army supervisor, to repel Boladaci.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，論功封朱永保國公，加汪直歲祿，陞賞者二千六百餘人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day xinwei, merit was discussed and Zhu Yong was enfeoffed as Duke of the State of Bao; Wang Zhi's annual stipend was increased; more than twenty-six hundred persons were promoted or rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinwei, after a merit review Zhu Yong was enfeoffed Duke of Bao, Wang Zhi's yearly stipend was raised, and more than twenty-six hundred men were promoted or rewarded.

sentences.zh: 是月，免四川、江西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That month, land tax and grain tribute in disaster-stricken Sichuan and Jiangxi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month land tax and grain tribute were forgiven in disaster-hit Sichuan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、安南、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Annam, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu, Annam, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 成化十六年

translations.literal: Chenghua year sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: The sixteenth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月甲午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, spring, first month, on the day jiawu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, in the first month of spring, on jiawu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，保國公朱永為平虜將軍，充總兵官，王越提督軍務，汪直監軍，禦亦思馬因於延綏。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Duke Zhu Yong of the State of Bao was made Pacifying the Barbarians General, filling the post of supreme commander; Wang Yue took overall command of military affairs; Wang Zhi supervised the army; they defended against Isibayan in Yan-Sui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zhu Yong, Duke of Bao, was made Pacifying the Barbarians General and supreme commander, with Wang Yue directing operations and Wang Zhi supervising the army, to meet Isibayan on the Yan-Sui frontier.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，免湖廣被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guiyou, land tax and grain tribute in disaster-stricken Huguang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiyou, land tax and grain tribute were remitted in disaster-stricken Huguang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王越襲亦思馬因於威寧海子，破之。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Wang Yue attacked Isibayan at Weining Lake and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Wang Yue struck Isibayan at Weining Lake and routed him.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，以歲歉減光祿寺供用物。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuzi, because of a lean harvest, Court of Imperial Entertainments supplies were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi, a poor harvest prompted cuts to Court of Imperial Entertainments provisions.

sentences.zh: 夏六月癸丑，禁勢家侵占民田。

translations.literal: In summer, sixth month, on the day guichou, powerful families were forbidden to encroach on commoners' fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on guichou, the throne forbade great houses from seizing commoners' farmland.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛酉，申存卹孤老之令。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on the day xinyou, the order to preserve and comfort orphans and the aged was reaffirmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on xinyou, the court reaffirmed its edict to shelter orphans and support the aged.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月庚申，亦思馬因犯大同。

translations.literal: In winter, twelfth month, on the day gengshen, Isibayan invaded Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on gengshen, Isibayan raided Datong.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，朱永、汪直、王越帥京軍禦之。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Zhu Yong, Wang Zhi, and Wang Yue led the capital army to defend against him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhu Yong, Wang Zhi, and Wang Yue marched the metropolitan army to meet him.

sentences.zh: 是月，總督兩廣軍務都御史朱英、總兵官平鄉伯陳政討廣西瑤，破之。

translations.literal: That month, Zhu Ying, supreme commander of military affairs in the Two Guangs, and Chen Zheng, Baron of Pingxiang and supreme commander, campaigned against the Guangxi Yao and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhu Ying, Two Guangs supreme commander, and Chen Zheng, Baron of Pingxiang and supreme commander, suppressed the Guangxi Yao and broke them.

sentences.zh: 是年，免兩畿、湖廣、河南、山東、雲南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That year, land tax and grain tribute in disaster-stricken districts of the Two Metropolitan Regions, Huguang, Henan, Shandong, and Yunnan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year land tax and grain tribute were forgiven in disaster districts of both metropolitan regions, Huguang, Henan, Shandong, and Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 琉球、暹羅、蘇門答剌、土魯番、撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu, Siam, Samudra, Turfan, and Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Embassies came from Ryukyu, Siam, Samudra, Turfan, and Samarkand.

sentences.zh: 成化十七年

translations.literal: Chenghua year seventeen.
translations.idiomatic: The seventeenth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月丙戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, spring, first month, on the day bingxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, in the first month of spring, on bingxu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，覈天下庫藏出納之數。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renxu, receipts and disbursements in treasuries throughout the realm were audited.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu, the court audited treasury receipts and outlays empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 是月，免浙江、山西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That month, land tax and grain tribute in disaster-stricken Zhejiang and Shanxi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month land tax and grain tribute were remitted in disaster-stricken Zhejiang and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，賜王華等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day xinmao, Wang Hua and others were granted jinshi with distinctions of first rank, origin, and so forth.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinmao, Wang Hua and others received jinshi degrees with distinctions of rank and origin.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，以久旱風霾敕羣臣修省。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day gengshen, because of prolonged drought and dusty winds, officials were ordered to practice self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen, prolonged drought and dusty gales prompted an order for ministers to undertake self-examination.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，諭法司慎刑獄。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the judiciary was instructed to be cautious in criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the throne admonished the judiciary to handle cases with care.

sentences.zh: 太監懷恩同法司錄囚，自是每五歲遣內臣審錄以為常。

translations.literal: The eunuch Huai En joined the judiciary in reviewing prisoners; from this time, every five years inner officials were sent to conduct judicial review as a regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Huai En joined the judiciary in reviewing prisoners; thereafter palace eunuchs were dispatched every five years for judicial review as standing practice.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，亦思馬因犯宣府。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Isibayan invaded Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Isibayan raided Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，汪直監督軍務，王越為平胡將軍，充總兵官，禦之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jihai, Wang Zhi supervised military affairs; Wang Yue was made Pacifying the Hu General, filling the post of supreme commander, to defend against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jihai, Wang Zhi took charge of operations and Wang Yue was made Pacifying the Hu General and supreme commander to repel him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，免南畿被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day jiaxu, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu, autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命所在鎮守總兵、巡撫聽汪直、王越節制。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, it was ordered that garrison supreme commanders and regional inspectors everywhere obey the direction of Wang Zhi and Wang Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu all frontier supreme commanders and regional inspectors were ordered to take direction from Wang Zhi and Wang Yue.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，振河南饑。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day renxu, famine in Henan was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renxu, relief was sent to Henan famine.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，取太倉銀三分之一入內庫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day wuzi, one-third of the silver in the Taicang treasury was taken into the inner treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuzi, one-third of Taicang treasury silver was transferred to the inner palace vault.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、占城、滿剌加、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam, Champa, Malacca, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, Champa, Malacca, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 安南黎灝侵老撾宣慰司，賜敕諭之。

translations.literal: Li Hao of Annam invaded the Laos Pacification Commission; an imperial letter of admonition was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Annam's Li Hao invaded the Laos Pacification Commission and was sent an imperial reprimand.

sentences.zh: 成化十八年

translations.literal: Chenghua year eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: The eighteenth year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月壬午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, spring, first month, on the day renwu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, in the first month of spring, on renwu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，劉吉起復。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Liu Ji was recalled to office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Ji was recalled from retirement.

sentences.zh: [一]三月已巳朔，振南畿饑。

translations.literal: [1] In the third month, on the new moon day yisi, famine in the Southern Metropolitan Region was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: [1] On the third-month new moon, jisi, the court sent relief to famine in the Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 壬申，罷西廠。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the Western Depot was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Western Depot was abolished.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑，罕慎復哈密城。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day guichou, Han Shen recovered Hami city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guichou, Han Shen retook Hami city.

sentences.zh: 甲子，免山西被災夏稅。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, summer tax in disaster-stricken Shanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi summer tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 五月，免山東、南畿被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, land tax and grain tribute in disaster-stricken Shandong and districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month land tax and grain tribute were remitted in disaster-hit Shandong and the Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，亦思馬因犯延綏，汪直、王越調兵禦敗之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renyin, Yisimayin raided Yan-sui; Wang Zhi and Wang Yue mobilized troops to resist and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renyin, Yisimayin struck Yan-sui; Wang Zhi and Wang Yue raised troops to meet him and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸丑，遣使振畿內、山東饑。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on the day guichou, envoys were dispatched to relieve famine in the metropolitan region and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on guichou, envoys were sent to relieve famine in the capital region and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，免河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, tax grain in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou tax grain was forgiven in disaster-hit Henan.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬申，倉副使應時用請罷饒州燒造御器內臣，下獄，贖還職。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day renshen, Assistant Granary Commissioner Ying Shiyong requested the dismissal of the eunuchs overseeing imperial porcelain manufacture at Raozhou; he was imprisoned, then ransomed and restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renshen, Assistant Granary Commissioner Ying Shiyong asked that the eunuchs supervising imperial porcelain at Raozhou be removed; he was jailed, then bought his way out and returned to office.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，免畿內、陝西、遼東被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken districts of the metropolitan region, Shaanxi, and Liaodong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, autumn grain tax was remitted in the capital region, Shaanxi, and Liaodong where disaster had struck.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，御製文華大訓成。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengwu, the imperially composed Wenhua Grand Instructions were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengwu, the Emperor's Wenhua Grand Instructions were completed.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、哈密、暹羅、土魯番、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu, Hami, Siam, Turfan, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu, Hami, Siam, Turfan, and Tibet sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 成化十九年

translations.literal: Chenghua year nineteen
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua nineteen

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月丙午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the day bingwu, the Emperor performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, on bingwu, the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，免湖廣被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingchen, tax grain in disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingchen, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Huguang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，免河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day dingchou, tax grain in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingchou, tax grain was remitted in disaster-hit Henan.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，汪直有罪，調南京御馬監。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yihai, Wang Zhi was found guilty and transferred to the Nanjing Imperial Horse Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai, Wang Zhi was judged guilty and reassigned to the Nanjing Imperial Horse Directorate.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，陳政破廣西瑤。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Chen Zheng defeated the Yao in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Chen Zheng routed the Yao in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，迤北小王子犯大同。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day xinchou, the Little Prince of the North raided Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinchou, the northern Little Prince struck Datong.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，總兵官許寧禦之，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Supreme Commander Xu Ning resisted him and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Supreme Commander Xu Ning met him in battle and was beaten.

sentences.zh: 己未，朱永為鎮朔大將軍，充總兵官，帥京軍禦之。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Zhu Yong was made Pacifying-the-North Grand General, served as supreme commander, and led capital troops to resist.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Zhu Yong was appointed Pacifying-the-North Grand General and supreme commander and led the capital army against the invaders.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，犯宣府，巡撫都御史秦紘、總兵官周玉禦却之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiazi, the enemy raided Xuanfu; Grand Coordinator Qin Hong and Supreme Commander Zhou Yu resisted and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiazi, raiders struck Xuanfu; Grand Coordinator Qin Hong and Supreme Commander Zhou Yu drove them back.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，戶部侍郎李衍、刑部侍郎何喬新巡視邊關。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Vice Minister of Revenue Li Yan and Vice Minister of Justice He Qiaoxin toured the border defenses.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Vice Ministers Li Yan of Revenue and He Qiaoxin of Justice inspected the frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 壬申，謫汪直為奉御，其黨王越、戴縉等貶黜有差。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Wang Zhi was demoted to palace attendant; his partisans Wang Yue, Dai Jin, and others were degraded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wang Zhi was reduced to palace attendant, and his allies Wang Yue, Dai Jin, and others were punished and demoted according to their crimes.

sentences.zh: 是月，朱永敗寇於大同、宣府。

translations.literal: That month Zhu Yong defeated the raiders at Datong and Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhu Yong defeated the raiders at Datong and Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，召朱永還。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day renshen, Zhu Yong was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renshen, Zhu Yong was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 是年，撒馬兒罕貢獅子。

translations.literal: That year Samarkand presented a lion in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Samarkand sent a lion as tribute.

sentences.zh: 成化二十年

translations.literal: Chenghua year twenty
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua twenty

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月庚寅，京師地震。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the day gengyin, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, on gengyin, an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，敕臣修省。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, an edict ordered all officials to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the throne ordered all officials to examine their conduct.

sentences.zh: 詔減貢獻，飭備邊，罷營造，理冤獄，寬銀課、工役、馬價，卹大同陣亡士卒。

translations.literal: An edict reduced tribute presentations, tightened frontier defense, halted construction projects, redressed wrongful imprisonments, eased silver levies, labor corvées, and horse prices, and provided for soldiers killed in action at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: An edict cut tribute demands, strengthened frontier readiness, stopped wasteful construction, cleared wrongful cases, eased silver levies, corvée labor, and horse prices, and compensated the families of men killed at Datong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the Emperor performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，賜李旻等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengyin, Li Min and other successful candidates of the metropolitan examination were granted jinshi ranks and appointments in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, Li Min and other metropolitan graduates received jinshi honors and appointments according to rank.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太監張善監督軍務，定西侯蔣琬充總兵官，同總督尚書余子俊備大同、宣府。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the eunuch Zhang Shan supervised military affairs; Marquis of Dingxi Jiang Wan served as supreme commander, together with Grand Secretary Yu Zijun as overall director, to prepare defenses at Datong and Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the eunuch Zhang Shan took charge of military affairs; Marquis of Dingxi Jiang Wan became supreme commander and, with Grand Secretary Yu Zijun as overall director, readied the defenses of Datong and Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，錄囚。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day wuwu, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuwu, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，再錄囚，減死罪以下。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiawu, prisoners were reviewed again and sentences below capital punishment were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiawu, prisoners were reviewed again and punishments below death were lightened.

sentences.zh: 六月，免南畿、陝西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, tax grain in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region and Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month tax grain was forgiven in the Southern Metropolitan Region and Shaanxi where disaster had struck.

sentences.zh: 秋九月乙酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, ninth month, on the new moon day yiyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on the new moon yiyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是月，寇復入居河套。

translations.literal: That month the raiders again settled in the Ordos bend.
translations.idiomatic: That month the raiders again occupied the Ordos bend.

sentences.zh: 是秋，陝西、山西大旱饑，人相食。

translations.literal: That autumn Shaanxi and Shanxi suffered severe drought and famine, and men ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn drought and famine ravaged Shaanxi and Shanxi until men ate one another.

sentences.zh: 停歲辦物料，免稅糧，發帑轉粟，開納米事例振之。

translations.literal: Annual procurement of materials was halted, tax grain was remitted, treasury grain was issued, and the grain-for-office contribution system was opened to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: The court halted annual requisitions, remitted tax grain, released treasury stores, and opened the grain-for-office contribution system to relieve the suffering.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，杖刑部員外郎林俊、都督府經歷張黻，並謫官。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day dingsi, Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice Lin Jun and an officer of the Chief Military Commission Zhang Fu were beaten with the stick and both demoted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingsi, Justice Vice Director Lin Jun and Chief Military Commission officer Zhang Fu were flogged and demoted.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，罷雲南元江諸府銀坑。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the silver mines of Yuanjiang and other prefectures in Yunnan were closed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the silver mines of Yuanjiang and other Yunnan prefectures were shut down.

sentences.zh: 十二月，免山西、河南被災夏稅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, summer tax in disaster-stricken Shanxi and Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month summer tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Shanxi and Henan.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、日本、琉球、哈密、土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: That year Annam, Japan, Ryukyu, Hami, and Turfan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, Japan, Ryukyu, Hami, and Turfan sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 成化二十一年

translations.literal: Chenghua year twenty-one
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua twenty-one

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月甲申朔，星變。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the new moon day jiashen, the stars showed irregular movement.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, on the new moon jiashen, the heavens showed irregular stars.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔臣極言時政。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, an edict ordered all officials to speak freely on current policy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict called on all officials to speak plainly about affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the Emperor performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣侍郎李賢、何喬新、賈俊振陝西、山西、河南饑。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Vice Ministers Li Xian, He Qiaoxin, and Jia Jun were dispatched to relieve famine in Shaanxi, Shanxi, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Vice Ministers Li Xian, He Qiaoxin, and Jia Jun were sent to relieve famine in Shaanxi, Shanxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，放免傳奉文武官五百六十餘人。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiwei, more than five hundred and sixty specially appointed civil and military officials were released from service.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiwei, more than five hundred and sixty specially appointed civil and military officials were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免陝西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, tax grain in disaster-stricken Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou tax grain was forgiven in disaster-hit Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，以泰山屢震遣使祭告。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day wuwu, because Mount Tai had repeatedly trembled, envoys were sent to offer sacrifices and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuwu, because Mount Tai had shaken repeatedly, envoys were sent to report and offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，轉漕四十萬石，振陝西饑。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, four hundred thousand piculs of grain transport were diverted to relieve famine in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu four hundred thousand piculs of transport grain were diverted to relieve famine in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，免南畿、山東被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That month tax grain in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region and Shandong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month tax grain was remitted in the Southern Metropolitan Region and Shandong where disaster had struck.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renxu, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renxu, an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙子，振京師饑民。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, famine victims in the capital were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi relief was distributed to famine victims in the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，令武臣納粟襲職。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinsi, military officials were permitted to present grain and inherit offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinsi, military officials were allowed to buy office by presenting grain.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔盛暑祁寒廷臣所奏毋得過五事。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, an edict ordered that in extreme heat or bitter cold court ministers' memorials should not exceed five items.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict ruled that in extreme heat or bitter cold ministers might submit no more than five items at court.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on the new moon day jimao, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the new moon jimao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，劉珝致仕。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiazi, Liu Xu retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiazi, Liu Xu retired.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，免山東、山西、河南、陝西、四川被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, tax grain in disaster-stricken Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Shaanxi, and Sichuan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Shaanxi, and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingyin, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingyin, an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，詹事彭華為吏部左侍郎兼翰林學士，入閣預機務。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiashen, Tutor Peng Hua was made Left Vice Minister of Personnel and Hanlin Academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to deliberate on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiashen, Tutor Peng Hua was made left vice minister of personnel and Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to deliberate on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲午，振南畿饑。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, famine in the Southern Metropolitan Region was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu relief was sent to famine victims in the Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 是冬，小王子犯蘭州、莊浪、鎮番、涼州。

translations.literal: That winter the Little Prince of the North raided Lanzhou, Zhuanglang, Zhenfan, and Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the northern Little Prince raided Lanzhou, Zhuanglang, Zhenfan, and Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 是年，哈密、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Hami and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hami and Tibet sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 成化二十二年

translations.literal: Chenghua year twenty-two
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua twenty-two

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月己未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the day jiwei, the Emperor performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, on jiwei, the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，免河南被災秋糧。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-hit Henan.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，免畿南及湖廣被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengchen, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken districts south of the capital and in Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengchen, autumn grain tax was remitted south of the capital and in Huguang where disaster had struck.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，清畿內勳戚莊田。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day yiwei, estates of meritorious nobles and imperial kin within the capital region were investigated and cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yiwei, estates held by meritorious nobles and imperial kin around the capital were investigated and regularized.

sentences.zh: 六月，免南畿、陝西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, tax grain in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region and Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month tax grain was forgiven in the Southern Metropolitan Region and Shaanxi where disaster had struck.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，敕臣修舉職業。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict ordered all officials to attend diligently to their duties.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict urged all officials to perform their offices with care.

sentences.zh: 甲午，諭法司慎刑。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the judiciary was instructed to apply punishments with caution.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the judiciary was instructed to punish with caution.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，小王子犯甘州，指揮姚英等戰死。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, the Little Prince of the North raided Ganzhou; Commander Yao Ying and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the northern Little Prince struck Ganzhou; Commander Yao Ying and others fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 九月，免河南、廣東被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, tax grain in disaster-stricken Henan and Guangdong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Henan and Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，兵部左侍郎尹直為戶部侍郎兼翰林學士，入閣預機務。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Left Vice Minister of War Yin Zhi was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Hanlin Academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to deliberate on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao War Vice Minister Yin Zhi was made vice minister of revenue and Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to deliberate on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸丑，占城為安南所侵，王子古來來奔。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day guichou, Champa was invaded by Annam; Prince Gulai fled to the court for refuge.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on guichou, Annam invaded Champa and Prince Gulai fled to the Ming court for refuge.

sentences.zh: 十二月，免江西、廣西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, tax grain in disaster-stricken Jiangxi and Guangxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Jiangxi and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 是年，哈密、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Hami and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hami and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 成化二十三年

translations.literal: Chenghua year twenty-three
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua twenty-three

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月，免陝西、湖廣被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, tax grain in disaster-stricken Shaanxi and Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Shaanxi and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the Emperor performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，副都御史邊鏞、邊政司參議田景賢巡視大同諸邊。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yiyou, Vice Censor-in-Chief Bian Yong and Frontier Affairs Commissioner Tian Jingxian toured the defenses of Datong and other sectors.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiyou, Vice Censor-in-Chief Bian Yong and Frontier Affairs Commissioner Tian Jingxian inspected the defenses along the Datong sector and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，彭華致仕。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingwei, Peng Hua retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingwei, Peng Hua retired.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賜費宏等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Fei Hong and other successful candidates of the metropolitan examination were granted jinshi ranks and appointments in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Fei Hong and other metropolitan graduates received jinshi honors and appointments according to rank.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，免山東被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, tax grain in disaster-stricken Shandong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai tax grain was forgiven in disaster-hit Shandong.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，免浙江被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day yihai, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Zhejiang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yihai, autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-stricken Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，旱，遣使分禱天下山川。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day yimao, because of drought envoys were dispatched to offer prayers at mountains and rivers throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yimao, drought prompted envoys to pray at mountains and rivers across the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，敕臣修省。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict ordered all officials to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict ordered all officials to examine their conduct.

sentences.zh: 是月，朵顏三避那孩入遼東，令駐牧近邊，給米布。

translations.literal: That month Bianai of the Duoyan Three Guards entered Liaodong; he was ordered to pasture near the border and was given rice and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: That month Bianai of the Duoyan Three Guards entered Liaodong; the court let him pasture near the frontier and supplied him with grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: [二]六月，免陝西、南畿被災秋糧。

translations.literal: [2] In the sixth month, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Shaanxi and the Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: [2] In the sixth month autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Shaanxi and the Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，封皇子祐杬為興王，祐棆岐王，祐檳益王，祐楎衡王，祐雍王。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day wushen, the imperial sons Youyuan, Youlun, Youbin, Youheng, and Youjing were enfeoffed as Princes of Xing, Qi, Yi, Heng, and Yong respectively.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wushen, the imperial sons Zhu Youyuan, Zhu Youlun, Zhu Youbin, Zhu Youheng, and Zhu Youjing were enfeoffed as Princes of Xing, Qi, Yi, Heng, and Yong.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，帝不豫。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengchen, the Emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengchen, the Emperor fell gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 甲申，皇太子攝事於文華殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the crown prince administered affairs at the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the crown prince took charge of affairs at the Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 己丑，崩，年四十有一。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the Emperor died, aged forty-one.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the Emperor died, aged forty-one.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，上尊諡，廟號憲宗，葬茂陵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yimao, posthumous titles were accorded; the temple name Xianzong was granted, and he was buried at Maoling.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yimao, posthumous honors were granted, the temple name Xianzong was bestowed, and he was buried at Maoling.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：憲宗早正儲位，中更多故，而踐阼之後，上景帝尊號，卹于謙之冤，抑黎淳而召商輅，恢恢有人君之度矣。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Xianzong secured the heirship early and passed through many trials before he took the throne; once enthroned he honored the Jingtai Emperor with a posthumous title, redressed the injustice done to Yu Qian, suppressed Li Chun and recalled Shang Lu—conduct that showed the breadth of a true ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Xianzong had been confirmed as heir early and weathered many trials before he took the throne; once enthroned he honored the Jingtai Emperor with a posthumous title, cleared Yu Qian's wrongful death, suppressed Li Chun and recalled Shang Lu—acts that showed the measure of a true ruler.

sentences.zh: 時際休明，朝多耆彥，帝能篤於任人，謹於天戒，蠲賦省刑，閭里日益充足，仁、宣之治於斯復見。

translations.literal: His age was one of peace and brilliance, and the court held many seasoned worthies; the Emperor was steadfast in appointing men, heedful of Heaven's warnings, remitting levies and easing punishments, so that villages grew ever more prosperous and the governance of Renzong and Xuanzong appeared again.
translations.idiomatic: His age was bright and settled, and the court held many seasoned worthies; the Emperor was steadfast in appointing men, heedful of Heaven's warnings, and generous in remitting levies and easing punishments, so that villages grew ever more prosperous and the governance of Renzong and Xuanzong seemed to return.

sentences.zh: 顧以任用汪直，西廠橫恣，盜竊威柄，稔惡弄兵。

translations.literal: Yet because he employed Wang Zhi, the Western Depot ran rampant, stole imperial authority, and, grown wicked through long license, toyed with war.
translations.idiomatic: Yet because he employed Wang Zhi, the Western Depot ran rampant, stole imperial authority, and—grown wicked through long license—stirred up war at will.

sentences.zh: 夫明斷如帝而為所蔽惑，久而後覺，婦寺之禍固可畏哉。

translations.literal: That a ruler so discerning should yet be deluded by such men, and only awaken after long delay, shows how dreadful the harm of women and eunuchs can be.
translations.idiomatic: That so discerning a ruler could still be misled, and only awaken after long delay, shows how dreadful the harm of palace women and eunuchs can be.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation notes

sentences.zh: [一] 庚寅劉吉起復 按本書卷一○九宰輔年表作「正月丁憂，七月起復」，憲宗實錄卷二二三正月庚寅條作「令吉奔喪，安葬畢日起復」，此記正月庚寅起復，是合「丁憂」「起復」為一事，顯有脫訛。

translations.literal: [1] On gengyin Liu Ji returned to office — this book, juan 109, Chronological Table of Chief Ministers, reads "first month, mourning leave; seventh month, returned to office"; the Xianzong Shilu, juan 223, entry for gengyin of the first month, reads "ordered Ji to hurry home for mourning and to return once the funeral was complete"; here the first month on gengyin is recorded as a return to office, evidently conflating mourning leave and return into one event, and the text is clearly corrupt.
translations.idiomatic: [1] "On gengyin Liu Ji returned to office": this book, juan 109, Chronological Table of Chief Ministers, reads "first month, mourning leave; seventh month, returned to office"; the Xianzong Shilu, juan 223, entry for gengyin of the first month reads "ordered Ji to hurry home for mourning and to return once the funeral was complete." Recording a return to office in the first month on gengyin conflates mourning leave and reinstatement into one event and is clearly corrupt.

sentences.zh: [二] 是月至給米布 是月，即五月，明史稿紀一一憲宗紀、憲宗實錄卷二九一均繫於六月己巳。

translations.literal: [2] From "that month" to "gave rice and cloth" — that month is the fifth month; the Draft History of the Ming, Annals 11, Xianzong Annals, and the Xianzong Veritable Records, juan 291, both date it to the sixth month on jisi.
translations.idiomatic: [2] "That month" through "gave rice and cloth": that month means the fifth month; the Draft History of the Ming, Annals 11, Xianzong Annals, and the Xianzong Shilu, juan 291, both place the entry under the sixth month on jisi.
